Cohen (3 mls) A.R.Shaw (S'Chase) F.A.Walker and A.F.Mitchell (Marathon) ........it was interesting to see that this year the "Sporting Life" compiled a table giving winners 6 points, down to 1 point for sixth place.

JIM ESTALL retained the A.F.Mitchell Shield as first Belgrave runner with a fine 2:25:22 on a bitterly cold day. At the half-way mark there were no less than three Belgrave stars ahead of Jim and it looked as if we might even pull off the team prize.

Our positions were as follows:- 3 V.S.Blowfield 56:46; 4 E.S.Stimpson 57:24; 7 L.W.Herbert 57:50; 10 F.J.Abberton 58:05; 15 T.P.Clinton 58:20; 36 C.T.Carter 60:01; 38 C.L.Stokell 60:05; 65 R.W.Tobin 61:37; 84 S.R.Eales 62:25; 90 A.E.Frost 62:50; 106 A.F.Mitchell 63:28; 132 G.M.Pearson 64:15.
